note: Policies were designed after inspecting Gold-480 consensus errors (design analysis, not a held-out result). They must not be changed before the one-time AP6 evaluation.

base_system.consensus_check_judge: blind judge: google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it, zero-shot, official TR-FactBench system prompt; K1/K2 outputs are NOT shown

P0_no_consensus_check.description: Current hybrid: only K1 != K2 cases go to the judge.

PA_label_ps_or_c.description: Also route consensus cases whose agreed label is partially_supported or contradicted.

PB_medical_and_label_ps_or_c.description: Also route consensus cases from the medical domain whose agreed label is partially_supported or contradicted (risk-based policy for high-stakes domains).

rejected_on_gold480.k1_confidence_threshold: 11/20 consensus errors have K1 confidence >= 0.96; threshold 0.95 gives net 0
